name: The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom

mods.reason: Echoes of Wisdom has no game app yet: it runs from its work folder, and its mods are set up by hand.

files.label: Base game
files.summary: Your copy of the game itself: the base game NSP you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: MacNativeGames merges its data with the update's. Reading it needs the keys from your Switch.

files.label: Update
files.summary: Your copy of the game's 1.1.0 update: the NSP file you dumped from your Switch.
files.detail: The game's code comes from this update.

files.label: Work folder
files.summary: The folder MacNativeGames worked in when it built the game app.
files.detail: It's named EoW_build unless you chose another name when building. The game runs from this folder and keeps its saves in the user-data folder inside it.
